A.description: Experiment A: logistic form on 4 time-pooled motion cues (coefficients from train only).

pooled_logistic.description: Logistic regression on mean and std over time of all 14 features (no temporal order).

reasons.B: Requires labelled real footage (Stage B: fine-tuning D and the from-scratch comparison B on the same camera-disjoint real splits); none was available.
reasons.D: Requires labelled real footage (Stage B: fine-tuning D and the from-scratch comparison B on the same camera-disjoint real splits); none was available.

disclaimer: Synthetic evaluation only: these numbers measure how well the motion signal of simulated, rendered sequences is learned and how robust it is to simulated nuisances. They are not real-world accuracy and do not show that the model reduces fog-related false alarms on real cameras.

real.reason: No labelled real surveillance footage with frame timing compatible with the model (its exported observation interval and flow lag, e.g. 12 observations ~5 s apart each with a frame ~1 s earlier for the near-field profile) was available; real-world validation is pending.

synthetic.exported_seed_selection: lowest val_select loss (early-stopping split) among seeds
